questions.question: The smallest number to which when 18 is added, the number is exactly divisible by 28, 36 and 45, is:
questions.solution:
Given:

The number is divisible by 28,36 and 45 when 18 is added

Concept used:

LCM method.

LCM is the smallest common multiple of two or more numbers.

Calculation:

LCM (28, 36, 45) = 1260

So, the smallest number divisible = 1260

Now, the required number = 1260 - 18 = 1242

**∴ The smallest number is divisible by 28,36 and 45 when 18 is added is 1242.**

questions.question: The average of 26 numbers is 54.5. The average of the first 15 numbers is 58.6 and that of the last 12 numbers is 52. If the 15th number is excluded, the average of the remaining numbers will be:
questions.solution:
Given:

The average of 26 numbers = 54.5

The average of the first 15 numbers = 58.6

The average of the last 12 numbers = 52

Concept used:

Total = Average × Number of entities

Calculation:

According to the question,

1st + 2nd + 3rd + .... + 15th = 58.6 × 15

⇒ 1st + 2nd + 3rd + .... + 15th = 879 ....(1)

26th + 25th + 24th + .... + 15th = 52 × 12

⇒ 26th + 25th + 24th + .... + 15th = 624 ....(2)

1st + 2nd + 3rd + .... + 15th + .... + 24th + 25th + 26th = 54.5 × 26

⇒ 1st + 2nd + 3rd + .... + 15th + .... + 24th + 25th + 26th = 1417 ....(3)

Adding equation(1) and equation(2),

1st + 2nd + 3rd + ... + 15th + 15th + .... + 24th + 25th + 26th = 1503

⇒ 1st + 2nd + 3rd + ... + 15th + 15th + .... + 24th + 25th + 26th = 1503

⇒ (1st + 2nd + 3rd + ... + 15th + .... + 24th + 25th + 26th) + 15th = 1503

⇒ 1417 + 15th = 1503 (From 3)

⇒ 15th = 1503 - 1417

⇒ 15th = 86

Now, the average of the remaining term = (1417 - 86)/(26 - 1)

⇒ 1331/25 = 53.24

**Hence, the average of numbers excluding 15th number is 53.24**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] __Alternate Method__**

The average of 26 numbers is 54.5

 The average of the first 15 numbers is 58.6, 

Which is (58.6 - 54.5) = 4.1 more than the total average,

So, the 1st, 15 numbers contributes (4.1 × 15) = 61.5 more

Similarly,

For the next 12 numbers (54.5 - 52) = 2.5 less than total average,

So, these 12 numbers contribute (2.5 × 12) = 30 less

Now, the 15th number will be 54.5 + (61.5 - 30) = 86,

The 15th number take out (86 - 54.5) = 31.5 more than the total

average, the loss of 31.5 will be distributed among the remaining

25 numbers,

So, the average of the remaining numbers is 

⇒ 54.5- ( 31.5/25 ) 

⇒ 54.5 - 1.26 = 53.24

Hence, the average of numbers excluding 15th number is 53.24

questions.question: A car runs 40 minutes at a speed of 45 km/h, next 45 minutes at a speed of 60 km/h and1{ {1} over 2} hours at a speed of 50 km/h. The average speed (in km/h) of the car for the whole journey is closest to:
questions.solution:
Given:

Speed of car in first 40 min = 45 km/h

Speed of car in next 60 min = 60 km/h

Speed of car in last 1.5 hours (90 min) = 50 km/h

Concept used:

Average speed = (Total distance covered)/(Total time taken)

Distance = Time × Speed 

Calculation:

Distance covered in the 40 minutes = 45 × 40/60 = 30 km

Distance covered in the 45 minutes = 60 × 45/60 = 45 km

Distance covered in the 1.5 hours = 50 × 1.5 = 75 km

Total distance covered = 30 + 45 + 75 = 150 km

Total time taken = 40/60 + 45/60 + 1.5

⇒ 2/3 + 3/4 + 3/2

⇒ 35/12 hours

Now, the average speed of the car for the whole journey = 150/(35/12)

⇒ 51.428 km/h ≈ 51.4 km/h

**∴ The average speed of car for the whole journey is closest to 51.4 km/h.**

questions.question: The radii of the bases of a cylinder and a cone are in the ratio of 4 : 3 and their heights are in the ratio of 1 : 2. Find the ratio of their volumes.
questions.solution:
Given:

Ratio of radius of base of the cylinder to cone = 4 : 3

Ratio of height of cylinder to cone = 1 : 2

Formula used:

Volume of a cylinder = πR2H

Volume of a cone = (π × R2 × H)/3

where R = Radius of the base, H = height

Calculation:

Let the radius of the cylinder and cone be 4k and 3k respectively,

And their heights be h and 2h respectively.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/72b66898dc55141ce4e5783f41c4345cc85ce7ee4d4d2250cfffa0dcf4a24df5.png] 

The volume of the cylinder = π × (4k)2 × H = 16πk²H

The volume of the cone = {π × (3k)2 × 2H}/3 = 6πk²H

Now, the ratio of their volumes = 16πk2H : 6πk2H

⇒ 8 : 3

∴ The ratio of their volumes is 8 : 3.

questions.question: In a school total student are only boys and girls. The ratio of boys and girls in a school is 5 : 8. Which of the following could be the total number of students in the school?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The given ratio of boys to girls is 5 : 8.

Total parts in the ratio = 5 + 8 = 13.

Since the number of students must be a whole number, the total must be exactly divisible by 13.

Checking the options, only 1690 is perfectly divisible by 13 (1690 ÷ 13 = 130).

**∴ The correct answer is 1690 students.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Ratio of boys to girls = 5 : 8

 
• 
 
• 
 
• 
 Total Students = 13x
 
 
 Boys (5x)
 
 
 Girls (8x)

 Total number must be a multiple of 13

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let the number of boys be 5x and the number of girls be 8x, where x is a positive integer.

⇒ Total number of students = 5x + 8x = 13x

⇒ This implies that the total number of students must be a multiple of 13.

⇒ Now, let's check the given options for divisibility by 13:

⇒ 2100 ÷ 13 ≈ 161.53 (Not an integer)

⇒ 1800 ÷ 13 ≈ 138.46 (Not an integer)

⇒ 2700 ÷ 13 ≈ 207.69 (Not an integer)

⇒ 1690 ÷ 13 = 130 (Perfectly divisible)

⇒ Only 1690 satisfies the condition of yielding a whole number of students.

**∴ The correct answer is 1690 students.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Divisibility in Ratios

When any discrete quantity (like humans, cars, animals) is divided in the ratio a : b, the total amount must be perfectly divisible by the sum of the ratio parts (a + b). Fractional entities are practically impossible.

Ratio Multiplier

The exact value of any component in a ratio is found by multiplying its ratio part by a common constant multiplier (x). Here, x represents the number of students per unit ratio part.

The list price of an article = ₹576. 

Discount = 20%

Cost price = ₹480.

Concept used:

Selling price = Marked Price - Marked Price × Discount%

Loss% = {(Cost Price - Selling Price) over Cost Price} × 100\%

Selling price = 576 - (576 × 20%)

⇒ 576 - 576 × 20/100

⇒ 576 - 115.20

⇒ ₹460.8

Now, loss% = [(480 - 460.8)/480] × 100

⇒ (19.2 × 100)/480

⇒ 1920/480 = 4

∴ The loss percentage is 4%.

questions.question: The ratio of three numbers is 3 : 2 : 5 and the sum of their squares is 8550. Find the sum of the numbers.
questions.solution:
Given:

The ratio of three numbers = 3 : 2 : 5

The sum of their squares is 8550. 

Calculation:

Let the numbers be 3k, 2k, and 5k respectively.

Sum of these numbers = 3k + 2k + 5k = 10k

According to the question,

(3k)² + (2k)² + (5k)2 = 8550

⇒ 9k² + 4k² + 25k² = 8550

⇒ 38k² = 8550

⇒ k² = 8550/38

⇒ k² = 225

⇒ k = ±15

⇒ k = +15 (considering the positive value only)

Now, the sum of the numbers = 10 × 15 = 150

∴ The sum of three numbers is 150.

questions.question: In an election between two candidates, 82% of voters cast their votes, out of which 4% were found to be invalid. The winning candidate got 108240 votes which are 55% of the valid votes. What was the total number of voters who cast their votes in this election?
questions.solution:

Total votes casted = 82%

Total invalid votes = 4%

Votes received by the winning candidate = 108240

Winner's vote = 55% of valid votes

Calculation:

Considering the total voters to be 100%.

Percentage of valid votes = 82 - (82 × 4%)

⇒ 82 - 3.28 = 78.72%

Percentage of votes the winning candidate got = 78.72 × 55%

⇒ 43.296%

According to the question,

43.296% votes = 108240

⇒ 1% = 108240/43.296

⇒ 1% = 2500

∴ 100% = 250000

Number of vote casted = 250000 × 82/100

⇒ 205000

**∴ The total number of voters who casted their votes is 205000.**

questions.question: An article was sold at a loss of 18%. Had that article been sold for ₹ 2,475 more, there would have been a profit of 12%. Find the selling price (in ₹) of the article.
questions.solution:
Given:

Loss on the article = 18%

Profit after adding ₹ 2,475 to SP = 12%

Formula used:

Selling Price = Cost Price - Cost Price × Loss%

Selling Price = Cost Price + Cost Price × Gain%

Calculation:

Let the cost price of the article be q

Original selling price = q - q × 18%

⇒q - (q × 18/100) = 0.82q

Desired selling price = q + q × 12%

⇒q + (q × 12/100) = 1.12q

According to the question,

1.12q - 0.82q = 2475

⇒ 0.3q = 2475

⇒ q = 2475/0.3

⇒ q = 8250

Now, the original SP of the article = 8250 × 0.82

⇒ ₹6765

**∴ The selling price of the article was ₹6765.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__ **

Let CP be 100%, therefore

⇒ (100 - 18)% + 2475 = (100 + 12)%

⇒ 82 % + 2475 = 112%

⇒ 112% - 82% = 2475

⇒ 30% = 2475

⇒ 1% = 2475/30 = 82.5

Then SP = 82% (At 18% loss)

⇒ SP = 82.5 × 82 = 6765

∴ The selling price of the article was ₹6765.

LCM method

questions.question: The radii of two circles are 21 cm and 25 cm. respectively. What is the area (in cm²) of the circle whose circumference is equal to difference of the circumference of the two given circles? (Use π ={ {22} over 7}) correct to one decimal place.
questions.solution:
Given:

Radius of first circle = 21 cm

Radius of second circle = 25 cm

Formula used:

Area of a circle = πR²

Circumference of the circle = 2πR

where R = Radius of the circle

Calculation:

Circumference of the first circle = (2π × 21) cm

Circumference of the second circle = (2π × 25) cm

Difference between the circumference = (2π × 25) - (2π × 21)

⇒ (2π × 4) = 8π cm

Let the radius of the above-mentioned circle be R.

According to the question,

2πR = 8π

⇒ R = 4

Now, the area of the circle = π × 4²

⇒ 22/7 × 16

⇒ 50.285 ≈ 50.3 cm²

**∴ The area (in cm²) of the obtained circle is 50.3 cm²**
